subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Utilizar, ao produzir texto, conhecimentos linguísticos e gramaticais: tempos verbais, concordância nominal e verbal, regras ortográficas, pontuação etc.

components.description_pt: Aplicar tempo verbal correto consistentemente ao escrever ou falar
components.description_en: Apply correct verb tense consistently when writing or speaking
components.cc_component_description: Apply correct verb tense consistently when writing or speaking

components.description_pt: Aplicar regras de concordância nominal e verbal na produção de texto escrito
components.description_en: Apply nominal and verbal agreement rules in written text production
components.cc_component_description: Use correct noun and verb agreement in written and spoken sentences

components.description_pt: Aplicar regras e padrões de ortografia para corrigir palavras mal escritas
components.description_en: Apply spelling rules and patterns to correct misspelled words in writing
components.cc_component_description: Apply spelling rules and patterns to correct misspelled words in writing

components.description_pt: Usar pontuação corretamente de acordo com as normas da língua portuguesa escrita
components.description_en: Use punctuation correctly according to the norms of written Portuguese
components.cc_component_description: Use punctuation marks including commas, semicolons, colons, and dashes correctly in writing

cc_matches.description: Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.
Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.
Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing.
